questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years. 5 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 5 : 2. What is the current age of the son?
questions.solution:
Let the age of father be F, and that of Son be S.

The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years.

F + S = 60

F = 60 – S ---(i)

5 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 5 : 2.

frac{{( {F + 5} )}}{{( {S + 5} )}} = (5)/(2)

=> 2F + 10 = 5S + 25 ---(ii)

Substituting the value of (i) in (ii), we get:

2(60 – S) + 10 = 5S + 25

=> 120 – 2S + 10 = 5S + 25

=> -2S – 5S = 25 – 10 – 120

=> - 7S = - 105

=> S = 15

Hence, the current age of son is 15 years.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
If the number of patients have increased, then the revenue should be more than double of the previous revenue as the fee is doubled. But the first conclusion says that the revenue has doubled, which implies that there is no change in the no. of patients. Therefore, the conclusion I follow.

With the doubled fee, if we have at least half as many patients as earlier, there cannot be a drop in the previous revenue. Since this is not the case, we can conclude that the number of patients has fallen by half. Therefore, conclusion II follows. Hence, both the conclusions follow.

Hence, **both conclusions I and II follow.**

questions.question: If the total energy of the reactants is more than the products of the reaction, heat is released and the reaction is said to be a/an ____ reaction.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**exothermic​.**__

__
 
• Exothermic reactions are reactions or procedures which release energy, usually in the form of heat or light.
 
• Energy is released in an exothermic reaction when the total energy of the components is below the total energy of the reactants.
 
• Exothermic reaction The total energy of the components of an exothermic reaction is less than the total energy of the reactants. The change in enthalpy is, therefore, negative, and heat is released into the surroundings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Endothermic reactions are reactions that require external energy for the reaction to proceed, usually in the form of heat.
 
• They seem to allow their environments to cool off, so endothermic responses draw heat from their surroundings. As endothermic reactions yield higher energy compounds than the reactants, they are also normally non-spontaneous.
 
• As such, the shift in enthalpy is always positive for an endothermic reaction. Heat is necessary to dissolve the ice cube, so the process is endothermic.

questions.question: Consider a planet whose mass and radius both are one half to that of Earth. An object of weight W on Earth will weigh ________ on that planet.

**Calculation:**__

Now, the mass of the planet M' = frac M2and the radius, r' = frac r2

Then the acceleration due to gravity is equal to g' = Gfrac {2M'}{r²}
